headline: Cardinals LT Paris Johnson out for season after tearing biceps
summary: Cardinals starting left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. is out for the season after tearing his left biceps in a 36-24 loss to the New York Giants on Sunday.

headline: Vikings LG Jackson likely out for season, LT Darrisaw has concussion
summary: Vikings left guard Donovan Jackson is headed for what is likely season-ending surgery to repair a meniscus tear, and left tackle Christian Darrisaw is in the concussion protocol.

headline: Sources: Eagles RB Tank Bigsby to have surgery, headed to IR
summary: Eagles running back Tank Bigsby sustained a core muscle injury Sunday that requires surgery, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: Packers LB Edgerrin Cooper has season-ending torn Achilles
summary: Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper suffered a season-ending Achilles tear during Sunday's 17-14 victory over the Buccaneers.

headline: MCL sprain sidelines Mariota while Daniels preps to practice
summary: In his team's loss to the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday, Washington Commanders quarterback Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained MCL of his right knee, and the timetable for his return remains uncertain coach Dan Quinn said on Monday.

headline: Chargers OT Rashawn Slater dealing with high ankle sprain
summary: Chargers offensive tackle Rashawn Slater suffered a high right ankle sprain in Sunday's loss to the Seahawks in Seattle, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday.
